About.title: About Kratos Natural
About.lead: Nice to meet you. Kratos Natural is the shop and research arm of Liam Kratos, orthomolecular therapist and longevity coach.
About.body1: We sell natural products, and we publish the research behind them. Not press releases, not marketing claims: systematic reviews and meta-analyses, read in full and reported with the numbers intact.
About.body2: If we cannot trace a claim to an indexed, published source, we do not make it. Every analysis lists its PMIDs so you can check the work yourself.
About.slide1Body: Slow your aging process with methods that have been tested.
About.slide2Body: Learn about longevity and anti-aging from A to Z.
About.slide3Body: Visit the shop for natural products of the highest quality.
